notes.body: Site visit report — Sunday Aug 2, 2:00 PM. MOD Madison Cureton. Crew worked diligently, quality and standards upheld. Punch list: expired coffee bottle in the walk-in, debris in line garbage cans, patty press cracked, grease on the hood, ice bucket stored wrong end up, mop sink debris, lobby/bathroom intake vents dusty, ceiling dripping in the lobby. Open signs were not illuminated on arrival. Lobby floor littered, tables needed cleaning. Strings on the potato bags. Guests were not greeted after shift change — 2nd shift managers were recently certified and need to understand why it matters. Label all produce cases with the discard date. Crew member on the register was on his phone; MOD handled it professionally.

No response in 4 days on the 'Internet connection issues' ticket — auto-closes in 4 more days. That ticket is the paper trail behind delivery being off. Reply today to keep it open.
